asked.item: Why Blotato tools don't load in Hermes

verdict.reason: The customer's config has a second mcp_servers key, which the help pages say makes the file invalid so Hermes loads the previous configuration without Blotato, and the pages give the correct single-key format.

steps.text: Your config.yaml has two mcp_servers keys, and a second key makes the file invalid.
When the file is invalid, Hermes keeps loading the previous configuration without Blotato.
Keep one mcp_servers key and add only the blotato entry under it.
Under that key, the blotato entry sets the url to https://mcp.blotato.com/mcp and sets blotato-api-key under headers, with your full API key in place of the placeholder.
